_comment: One object per news item, newest first. The homepage shows the first three. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, excerpt (a sentence or two), image (path under /assets/, blank shows a placeholder), alt (describes the image for screen readers) and url (optional link to the full story; leave blank for none).

items.title: Research led by Prof. Ming Chan reveals modulating chromatin dynamics of H2B mutations, shedding light on novel targeted therapy of breast cancer
items.excerpt: A research team led by Prof. Kui-ming Chan from CityUHK BMS discovered that H2BE113K, a missense H2B mutation, promotes colony formation and lung metastasis of breast cancer.
items.alt: Prof. Ming Chan in a lab coat and gloves holding up a pipette and culture dish

items.title: Breakthrough studies from Prof. Kui Ming Chan’s team reveal how histone mutations drive cancer — and how they can be targeted
items.excerpt: New studies by Prof. Kui Ming Chan’s research team reveal how cancer-causing histone mutations drive cancer and expose therapeutic vulnerabilities for precision therapies.
items.alt: Portraits of five research team members above the Science Advances and Cell Reports papers on histone H2B mutations
